stubbed_calls.description: flash programming primitive; writes to simulated memory only

timer_model.elapsed_units: firmware source-timer decrement opportunities; not asserted to be milliseconds
timer_model.execution: worker then one source-timer decrement, until idle; save ticks exercised separately

limitations: Peripheral/analog behavior, real flash erase/programming and power-loss persistence are not emulated.
No bootloader, USB UPDATE, signature acceptance or physical MCU capacity is tested here.
No interrupt preemption or concurrent CEC/USB/power/protection task scheduling is emulated.
Power/protection checks exercise dispatcher guards with fixed RAM states, not physical fault sensing.
Zero-return ABI stubs and enumerated RAM states limit conclusions to the paths listed above.
